prerequisites: TECHNOLOGY OF PRODUCTION AND MANUFACTURING (3rd year)

learning_outcomes.text: Acquire knowledge and skills in mechanical manufacturing assisted by numerical control. ISO programming code.
Acquire the fundamental concepts of computer programming for a machine tool.
Understand the necessary software for programming and be able to establish communication between the computer and the machine tool's numerical control.
Know how to set up the tools of a numerical control machine to carry out machining.
Understand the control panels of a machine tool and know how to input the elaborated programming to carry out machining.
Aptitude for the distribution of resources and times and their implementation in real situations.
Ability to transmit concepts, ideas, processes, etc., related to Industrial Engineering orally and in writing, clearly and correctly.
Ability to use scientific-technical tools for solving calculation and design problems in Industrial Engineering and aptitude for finding sustainable engineering solutions.
Ability to work collaboratively and capacity for developing multidisciplinary projects.
Ability to incorporate new knowledge in the area of Industrial Engineering, based on the acquired training and necessary for the evolution of technique.
Applied knowledge of manufacturing systems and processes, metrology, and quality control.

syllabus_topics: Programming languages for Numerical Control machine tools
ISO programming of a CNC machine
Specific functions for milling machines and lathes
teaching_methods: Evaluation tests (objective tests, short questions, practical and oral tests)

assessment_methods.method: Group work, leadership, involvement in group activities

assessment_rules: The evaluation system will assess the acquisition of competencies, demonstrating them jointly through a continuous assessment process and the increasing introduction of capabilities and skills throughout the course. Criteria for evaluation will be communicated in each case.
